- Ben (sales) action: I’ll put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestone owners and a target contract-signature runway and circulate by EOD tomorrow.
- Acme action: Please confirm who from procurement/legal will be the signer and whether there are calendar constraints on signatures (procurement windows / board approvals).

Proposed target close (initial): July 29, 2027 — this gives a window for legal redlines and security review, but if procurement needs more runway we can shift. I’ll flag alternate dates in the MAP.

Attachments: none yet — MAP draft coming in next message.

Next steps (short):
1) I will send a draft MAP with explicit milestone owners and dependencies (security evidence, SOW, pricing).
2) Can Acme confirm procurement contact + any blackout dates by end of day?
3) If procurement requires an August signature window, note that in reply and we’ll propose an adjusted timeline.

Looking forward — Ben

Ben / Sergio — I drafted an initial MAP based on the call and Acme’s procurement constraints. Attaching MAP_v1.pdf and the SOW draft for review. High level:

Two acceptance lanes in the doc:
- Standard lane (aligns with Acme’s Aug 5 signature runway) — conservative: allows procurement and finance approvals to complete on their calendar.
- Expedited lane (internal target July 29 signature) — requires accelerated security evidence and prioritized legal turnaround.

Proposed milestone owners and dates (internal recommendations):
- Sales (Ben Carter): Demo + finalize scope (by 2027-07-12)
- Legal (Sergio Alvarez): Redlines returned (by 2027-07-18)
- Security evidence (Mina Haddad, security): SOC 2 scoping & evidence summary (deliver by 2027-07-20 for expedited lane, 2027-07-26 for standard lane)
- Solution architect (Dev Patel): SOW finalization and deployment runbook (by 2027-07-19)
- Customer procurement (Acme): Procurement meeting + signature confirmation (requested by 2027-07-23 for expedited lane, final signature 2027-08-05 for standard lane)

Dependencies called out in MAP_v1.pdf:
- SOC 2: customer requires attestation/summary. If only attest available we will provide targeted controls mapping.
- Customer onboarding (IDEM / vendor setup): finance needs vendor form completed before signature.

Recommendation: propose we send MAP_v1 to Acme as-is but call out that we can commit to Aug 5 as formal signature date if they require, while offering an expedited path if they can accelerate procurement signoff and security evidence review.

Please review the owners/dates and flag any concerns — I tried to keep dates tight but feasible.

Attachments: MAP_v1.pdf, SOW-draft.docx

Elena / Tom — thank you for the clarity on your side. I’ve reviewed Laura’s draft MAP and want to confirm Redwood’s position so we can lock calendar commitments: 

1) Formal signature date: we can align to Acme’s stated procurement runway and treat 2027-08-05 as the formal contract signature deadline. We will treat that as the canonical date in the MAP unless Acme signals an earlier runway.

2) Expedited path: we will offer the expedited lane (target July 29) if Acme can confirm by EOD Friday (2027-07-23) that procurement will prioritize the vendor packet and legal can turn redlines within 3 business days. Specific asks to enable expedited lane:
   - Procurement: commit to an internal meeting on or before 2027-07-26 to sign off on finance/vendor onboarding items.
   - Legal: Claire (cc’d by Acme) to confirm expected redline cadence (we need returned redlines by 2027-07-18 to hit the expedited path).
   - Security: we will provide a controls summary and SOC-related artifacts by 2027-07-20 (Laura has outlined the deliverables).

3) Next immediate steps (actions I’ll take):
   - I will send an updated MAP (MAP_v2.pdf) that explicitly lists the two lanes, milestone owners and dates, and the single-point-of-contact for procurement.
   - Sergio will prepare a short contract fallback (terms we can accept to accelerate signature) and circulate to Claire for an informal pre-review.

4) Ask of Acme right now: please confirm the procurement signatory and whether Acme can commit to the July 26 procurement meeting (even if Aug 5 remains the formal signature date). That single confirmation will let us prioritize resources on our side.

Quoting Laura’s milestone owners below for quick reference:
> - Sales (Ben Carter): Demo + finalize scope (by 2027-07-12)
> - Legal (Sergio Alvarez): Redlines returned (by 2027-07-18)
> - Security evidence (Mina Haddad): deliverable by 2027-07-20 (expedited) / 2027-07-26 (standard)

I’ll attach MAP_v2 in the next message; if Acme confirms the procurement meeting date we’ll push on the expedited lane.

Thanks — Ben
